name: Prime Urban Development India Limited
about: Prime Urban Development India Limited engages in realty development business in India. The company develops luxury high-end residential communities, malls, shopping and office complexes, and independent villas. It is also involved in trading and investment businesses. In addition, the company exports cotton yarns under the Prime brand to Korea, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Japan, Malaysia, China, Taiwan, Bangladesh, Turkey, and other countries. The company was formerly known as Prime Textiles Limited. Prime Urban Development India Limited was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Mumbai, India.
